name: rocksoft-koda
description: Rocksoft Koda for Claude and Codex — the rs-feature skill turns a client's feature or change request into a ready-to-build GitHub issue in their repository, through the Rocksoft Flow MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Describe a feature or a change in your own words. Rocksoft Koda talks it through with you, drafts a ready-to-build GitHub issue in your repository and creates it only after your explicit yes.
defaultPrompt: I want to add a new feature to our project
We need to change how an existing screen works
